activities.activity_name: Rerun performance tests for Kafka comparison
activities.activity_description: Set up test configuration, run baseline/Tuple/Serialized payloads against Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 with specified sinks (In-Memory->Hdfs, DirectBinding->Hdfs, Kafka->Hdfs), collect and compare results.
Update Gradle build file to use Reactor 2.0.3, adjust code for any breaking changes, run unit and integration tests to verify compatibility.
Modify application configuration to set JMX enabled flag to false by default, update documentation if needed, and ensure no negative impact on existing features.

Run build with warnings enabled, fix all compiler warnings (deprecations, unchecked, etc.) and Javadoc issues; ensure clean build output.

activities.activity_description: Create or update documentation describing how to use the analytics tab widgets in the streaming pipeline, including explanations of each widget.
